scenarios.title: Headless render and interaction smoke test
steps: Run the existing scripted mock-controller loop.
scenarios.evidence: At least one fresh rendered frame and a passing semi-play result.

scenarios.title: Receiver reload and ammo quad
markers: Tactical Gesture: MANUAL WEAPON RELOAD triggered
steps: In the cell block/yard, equip a sidearm.
Bring the off-hand to the receiver and perform a reload.
Look at the receiver display and confirm live digits, not background, are visible.
scenarios.evidence: Fresh hook log plus an eye-frame capture; record whether the ammo digits fit the configured crop.

scenarios.title: NanoMED interaction
markers: NANOMED CARTRIDGE INSERTED INTO STATION RECEIVER
steps: Draw a cartridge from the waist pouch.
Present an open palm at the NanoMED station and insert the cartridge.
scenarios.evidence: Fresh hook log and a frame capture of the interaction.

scenarios.title: Ladder grab and mantle grace window
steps: Grip a rung above shoulder height and pull down to climb.
At a ledge, pull with one hand, then the other within the mantle grace window.
scenarios.evidence: Fresh hook log; note whether the mantle-ready hint and completion pulse appear.

scenarios.title: Grab, drag, and throw
markers: Physical Gesture: OBJECT THROW / PROPULSION executed
steps: Grip a movable object or body.
Move it while held, then release during a forward arm swing.
scenarios.evidence: Fresh hook log and a frame capture. Marker names may vary by object path.

scenarios.title: Physical melee strike
steps: Equip fists or a melee weapon.
Perform a deliberate forward strike, then verify guard disengages on the strike.
scenarios.evidence: Fresh hook log and a frame capture of the encounter.

scenarios.title: Grenade draw, prime, and throw
steps: Draw a grenade from the chest bandolier.
Bring the off-hand to the grenade, grip to prime, then throw.
scenarios.evidence: Fresh hook log and a frame capture.

scenarios.title: Drone aim and disconnect
markers: EMERGENCY NEURAL EJECTION / DRONE DISCONNECT triggered
steps: Move the aim controller independently of the HMD, then use the dual-stick disconnect gesture.
scenarios.evidence: Fresh hook log and a frame capture showing the drone view/reticle.
